input.description: Check if the Postgres container is running

content.text: Container's running. I'll dump the `fight_ai` Postgres DB using `pg_dump` inside the container and save it to the repo root as a timestamped `.dump` file (custom format, so it's restorable with `pg_restore`).

input.command:
TS=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
docker exec fight_ai pg_dump -U admin -d fight_ai -Fc -f /tmp/backup.dump
docker cp fight_ai:/tmp/backup.dump "./fight_ai_backup_${TS}.dump"
docker exec fight_ai rm /tmp/backup.dump
ls -lh "fight_ai_backup_${TS}.dump"
